candidates.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one square vocabulary illustration. Style: hand-painted gouache with colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft daylight, muted natural green, blue and coral, centered compact scene in middle 70 percent with generous clean margins, readable on a small card. No text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, card UI, panels or collage. Exact target: attempt / n. / 尝试. Show a determined young child making an unsuccessful first attempt to reach an apple hanging just beyond their outstretched fingertips. The child stands on tiptoes and stretches upward with visible effort, the apple remains attached and clearly a short gap beyond the fingers, and several small failed hand-position motion traces near the reaching arm indicate repeated trying without success. Only one child, one low tree branch and the target apple, a stable ground beneath their feet. Keep the effort and not-yet-achieved goal the clear focus. No adults helping, no bicycle, ladders, victory, eating, arrows, thought bubbles or text. Anatomically correct body and one pair of arms.

provisionalVisualReview.method: Actual generated image individually viewed; target mapping known; assessed visible subject/action without depending on word labels.

recoveryVisualReview.method: Actual returned native image viewed, image-only interpretation assessed with exact target known.
recoveryVisualReview.interpretation: Boy stretches on tiptoe repeatedly toward apple beyond fingertips; ghost hand positions show repeated reaching.
recoveryVisualReview.reason: Effort and unachieved goal are visible, but image still primarily reads reaching/picking an apple or inability to reach, without sufficiently distinguishing the general noun 尝试; repeated ghost hands also risk distracting anatomy. Keep pending instead of claiming exact-sense acceptance.
